latest.notes:
Receive payment shows what the payment covers and how much the customer is giving. Extra money can go to their wallet
An order marked delivered by mistake can be set back to Placed with Not delivered yet
Cancel a placed or delivered order, put goods back in stock, and give the money back or add it to their wallet
Bank fields use a searchable list of Sri Lankan banks

Receive payment keeps the ticked total fixed and lets you type how much the customer is giving. Extra money above every unpaid order goes to their wallet
Not delivered yet puts a mistaken delivery back to Placed. Stock and what they owe update; money already received stays on the order
Cancel an order at any time. Delivered goods go back to stock, what they still owe is cleared, and paid money can be given back or added to their wallet
Orders has a Cancelled tab for stopped orders
Bank fields use a searchable list of Sri Lankan banks when you edit a cheque, record a cheque, or set a supplier bank
